subject.title: feat: verify AI access during macOS onboarding before the first chat

question: Should this broad branch land as one onboarding/setup package, or should it be narrowed to verified macOS AI onboarding after the auth/config safety blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds new onboarding/product RPC behavior and now includes unrelated feature surfaces, so maintainer intent is needed after the concrete blockers are repaired.

options.title: Narrow and repair before merge
options.body: Keep the verified AI onboarding work, fix the auth/config blockers, and split unrelated Watch, voice-call, WhatsApp, Control UI, i18n, and changelog changes into their own PRs.

options.title: Accept the broad branch
options.body: Merge all included surfaces only after the relevant owners explicitly sign off and the auth/config blockers are fixed.

options.title: Pause for a fresh PR
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if maintainers want a smaller contributor branch rebuilt around the core onboarding issue.

recommendation.title: Narrow and repair before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the verified AI onboarding work, fix the auth/config blockers, and split unrelated Watch, voice-call, WhatsApp, Control UI, i18n, and changelog changes into their own PRs.
